purpose: Teach: インストラクター/障壁/離職/測量/バリアフリー/粉飾/生計/ステータス

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員向けインストラクターを招いて研修しろ
lines.en: We'll bring in an external instructor and conduct staff training.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. Direct gaze. Each clause lands with purpose. No softness — this is instruction, not suggestion. Slight pause between thoughts.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市場参入の障壁を分析しております
lines.en: Yes. We're currently analyzing the barriers to market entry.
lines.style: Respectful but grounded. Measured pace. No rush — he's reporting fact, not seeking approval. Steady eye contact, shoulders level. Professional distance held.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、離職率を低減する対策を進めろ
lines.en: Implement measures to reduce our staff turnover.
lines.style: Firm directive. Weight on the verb. Slight lean forward — this matters to him. Not harsh, but the kind of clarity that expects action. Hold the final word.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新工場の測量を完了いたしました
lines.en: Yes. We've completed the survey for the new facility.
lines.style: Prompt, professional acknowledgment. Slightly brighter than before — he's reporting progress. Upright posture. No hesitation. The tone of someone delivering what was asked of him.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社屋のバリアフリー化を進めろ
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Not loud, but it carries. Deliberate pause before speaking. The kind of direction that implies this reflects his values. No room for negotiation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。決算の粉飾は絶対に許さない方針です
lines.en: Yes. Our policy is uncompromising — we will not tolerate accounting misconduct.
lines.style: Serious, almost solemn weight on this one. Slower pace. He's meeting Hiroshi's steadiness with his own. This line carries more gravity than before. Slight tension in the jaw.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員の生計を支える経営しろ
lines.en: We need to manage this company in a way that genuinely supports our staff's livelihoods.
lines.style: Quietly philosophical. Slower tempo. Hiroshi speaks from deeper conviction here — this isn't just business. Almost contemplative. Slight exhale before the final clause.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新ブランドのステータスを高めます
lines.en: Yes. We'll elevate the new brand's market position.
lines.style: Final affirmation, slightly warmer. Professional but with a hint of forward momentum. Clean, decisive close. Kenji matches the register but releases a fraction of tension.
